roadmap.title: New Game on Story difficulties
roadmap.description: Play the first run on Story action and Story puzzle difficulty, collect everything available, and finish the Normal ending. Win the Shiromuku fight without dying and clear the fog-monster, boss and puzzle challenges as they come.

roadmap.title: New Game+ with Hard puzzles
roadmap.description: Start New Game+ on Hard puzzles. Without taking Red Capsules, build the Sacred Sword, open every Inari-sama seal, take the UFO ending, then finish the Fox Wets Its Tail ending.

roadmap.title: New Game++ with Lost in the Fog puzzles
roadmap.description: Start New Game++ on Lost in the Fog puzzles. Buy all upgrades and hokora omamori, clear the remaining documents, then finish Fox's Wedding and Ebisugaoka in Silence with the purified sword and Brooch.

roadmap.title: Action Lost in the Fog run
roadmap.description: Finish one more run on Lost in the Fog action difficulty to unlock all three action-difficulty achievements.

achievements.description: The baby bird takes her first steps.
achievements.summary: Finish the first chapter by finding the Chizuruya General Store in Ebisugaoka.

steps.text: Reach the @loc{Chizuruya General Store} in Ebisugaoka.

achievements.description: The fox watches over the chicken coop.
achievements.summary: Finish the second chapter, which centers on the altar puzzle and three Ema on the shrine path.

steps.text: Work out the altar puzzle, then locate three @item{Ema} on the shrine path.

achievements.description: As you bask in the sun, I sink into the shadows.
achievements.summary: Finish the third chapter by crossing the rice fields and reaching Rinko's house.

steps.text: Get through the scarecrow rice fields and reach @loc{Rinko's house}.

achievements.description: Wash thoroughly before eating.
achievements.summary: Finish the fourth chapter by getting through the corridors and defeating the first boss.

steps.text: Get through the corridors and defeat the first boss.

achievements.description: The little sparrow escapes with its friends, wings flapping nervously...
achievements.summary: Finish the fifth chapter by reaching Ebisugaoka Middle School.

steps.text: Travel across Ebisugaoka until you arrive at the @loc{Middle School}.

achievements.description: What exactly have we learned?
achievements.summary: Finish the sixth chapter at the Middle School by opening the Secret Box and cracking the locker codes.

steps.text: Inside the @loc{Middle School}, get the key to the second floor, unlock the Secret Box, and work out the locker combinations.

achievements.description: You have no place in my future.
achievements.summary: Finish the seventh chapter by solving the light puzzle and finding Shu's treasured possession in the Worship Hall.

steps.text: Solve the light puzzle and find Shu's most treasured possession in the @loc{Worship Hall}.

achievements.description: For whom do I tread such a treacherous path?
achievements.summary: Finish the eighth chapter by finding the way to Shu's house in Sugisato.

steps.text: Find the way to @npc{Shu}'s house in Sugisato.

achievements.description: Anything for you.
achievements.summary: Finish the ninth chapter by locating all three ritual chambers inside the Main Hall and beating the second boss.

steps.text: Locate each of the ritual chambers inside the @loc{Main Hall}, then beat the second boss.

achievements.description: Good terms? No. I'm here to burn bridges.
achievements.summary: Finish the tenth chapter by solving the Shimizu Residence puzzles and defeating the third boss.

steps.text: Solve the puzzles in the @loc{Shimizu Residence}, then defeat the third boss.

achievements.description: Two portals open; doors to a secret world.
achievements.summary: Finish the eleventh chapter by completing the Treasure Hall mural puzzle.

steps.text: Complete the mural puzzle found in the @loc{Treasure Hall}.

achievements.description: I refuse.
achievements.summary: Finish the twelfth chapter by escaping the Fog Monster.

steps.text: Escape the Fog Monster.

achievements.description: I accept.
achievements.summary: Finish the thirteenth chapter by returning to the Shimizu estate.

steps.text: Return to the @loc{Shimizu} estate.

achievements.description: Drown in a bottomless pit of self-doubt.
achievements.summary: Finish the game for the first time and see the Normal ending.

guide.context: In New Game+ this ending needs at least one Red Capsule taken and the UFO route skipped.

steps.text: Play the story through to the end of your first playthrough. The last boss is the @enemy{Shiromuku}.

achievements.description: Dolls are happiest when they are loved.
achievements.summary: See the Fox's Wedding ending after getting the Agura no Hotei-sama.

steps.text: On New Game+ with a save that has already seen the Normal ending, do not take any @item{Red Capsule}.
Pick up the @item{Agura no Hotei-sama} from the @loc{Hermitage of Crimson Water}.
Purify the @item{Sacred Sword}, or never pick it up.
Play to the end. The final boss is the @enemy{Tsukumogami}.

achievements.description: A hell of your own choosing. Nothing else matters, now.
achievements.summary: Reach the Fox Wets Its Tail ending while carrying an unpurified Sacred Sword.

guide.context: Leave the sword unpurified, and keep the Brooch away from the ancient Jizo in this run.

steps.text: On New Game+ with a save that has already seen the Normal ending, do not take any @item{Red Capsule}.
Get the @item{Sacred Sword} from the Jizo offerings and keep it unpurified.
Play to the end. The final fight starts against the @enemy{Shiromuku} and ends against the @enemy{Shichibi}.

achievements.description: We need to talk about our future.
achievements.summary: See the Ebisugaoka in Silence ending after earning two other full endings.

steps.text: Start a New Game++ run.
Your save must hold two distinct full endings already; the UFO ending is not one of them.
Do not take any @item{Red Capsule}.
Get the @item{Sacred Sword} and purify it.
While heading for the Shimizu Residence, hand the @item{Brooch} over at the ancient Jizo statue.
Play to the end. The final bosses are the @enemy{Tsukumogami} and the @enemy{Kyubi}.

achievements.description: Rise up! The Space Army is coming!
achievements.summary: See the UFO ending in New Game+.

guide.context: Do not enter the house straight after Rinko opens a hole in the wall. That locks you out of the third poster and the store. Save after the ending to keep the PP-8001 weapon for later runs.

steps.text: Use a New Game+ save that has already seen the Normal ending.

Early in the game, once the first Fog Monster chase is over, cross the waterway. A ledge on the right leads to the bloody-mask house; skip it, go back over the waterway, and follow the narrow path on the left. Let the radio broadcast play to the end.
Look for the first Great Space Invasion poster in the hay shed beside a farmhouse in the rice field east of the @loc{Doctor's House}. Move the wooden planks to get in.
Look for the second poster next to the first hokora in the alleys leading to the @loc{Middle School}.
Return to the side yard of the @loc{Chizuruya General Store}; the third poster is on the house by the tree.
Read the movie review on the bench in front of the store.
Beat the monster at the store, then examine the flying saucer sitting on the outdoor table.

achievements.description: Complete the game with action difficulty set to "Story" or higher.
achievements.summary: Finish the game at Story action difficulty or above.

guide.context: The UFO ending does not count. Action difficulty achievements stack.

steps.text: Finish a full ending on Story action difficulty or higher.

achievements.description: Complete the game with action difficulty set to "Hard" or higher.
achievements.summary: Finish the game at Hard action difficulty or above.

guide.context: The UFO ending does not count.

steps.text: Reach a full ending while action difficulty is Hard or Lost in the Fog.

achievements.description: Complete the game with action difficulty set to "Lost in the Fog".
achievements.summary: Finish the game with action difficulty on Lost in the Fog.

guide.context: This one run also unlocks the Story and Hard action achievements. The UFO ending does not count.

steps.text: Begin a New Game+ after buying every stat upgrade and two or more extra omamori slots, and choose Lost in the Fog for action difficulty.
Take a @item{Red Capsule} so the game ends with the Normal ending and the @enemy{Shiromuku} boss.
Collect health items, Toolkits, Kitchen Knives and Divine Water bottles. Equip @item{Tanuki}, @item{Boar}, @item{Weasel} and @item{Spider} omamori.
Use Light Attacks with a Kitchen Knife and repair it with Toolkits. Drink Divine Water to restore Sanity and reduce Sanity damage. In the parents fight, focus on the father.
Finish the game. Do not accept an offer to lower difficulty.

achievements.description: Complete the game with puzzle difficulty set to "Story".
achievements.summary: Finish the game with puzzle difficulty on Story.

guide.context: Puzzle difficulty achievements do not stack, so each needs its own run. The UFO ending does not count.

steps.text: Finish a full ending with puzzle difficulty on Story.

achievements.description: Complete the game with puzzle difficulty set to "Hard".
achievements.summary: Finish the game with puzzle difficulty on Hard.

guide.context: Puzzle difficulty achievements do not stack, so each needs its own run.

steps.text: Finish a full ending with puzzle difficulty on Hard.

achievements.description: Complete the game with puzzle difficulty set to "Lost in the Fog".
achievements.summary: Finish the game with puzzle difficulty on Lost in the Fog.

guide.context: Puzzle difficulty achievements do not stack, so each needs its own run.

steps.text: Finish a full ending with puzzle difficulty on Lost in the Fog.

achievements.description: Escaped from the Fog Monster at Ebisugawa without getting hit.
achievements.summary: Escape the first Fog Monster at Ebisugawa without being hit.

steps.text: It shows up during the talk with Shu, Rinko and Sakuko outside the @loc{Chizuruya General Store}.
Run away without touching any red-glowing, spore-emitting vine and without being hit.
If you are hit, die and choose Continue, or reload the autosave.

achievements.description: Opened the Shrine Vault at the Shrine Path without getting hit.
achievements.summary: Open the Shrine Vault on the Shrine Path without being hit by a monster.

steps.text: Solve the Shrine Vault puzzle without taking a monster hit.
On New Game+, skip the Ema-symbol part. Go straight to the vault and enter the code.

achievements.description: Arrived at the Nishida residence without making a single mistake on the scarecrow puzzle.
achievements.summary: Solve the scarecrow puzzle in front of Rinko's house without removing a wrong thorn.

guide.context: The correct thorns depend on the puzzle difficulty you chose.

steps.text: Remove only the correct thorns in the field puzzle. If you remove a wrong one, reload the autosave.

Story puzzle difficulty, in order: left scarecrow with a sickle; middle scarecrow without a sickle; right scarecrow with the bird brooch; smiling scarecrow behind the closest male scarecrow; farthest female scarecrow.
Hard puzzle difficulty, in order: middle-left female scarecrow; middle one that has a sickle lodged in its back; leftmost; rightmost; then the sickle-in-back one once more.

Lost in the Fog puzzle difficulty, in order: left one without a sickle; one whose sickle is stuck in the field; farthest right one without a sickle; middle-right one; the lone one far in the northwest.

achievements.description: Opened the Igarashi residence's mailbox.
achievements.summary: Open the mailbox at Sakuko's house.

steps.text: Take the @item{Key to Sakuko's Mailbox} from the Sennensugi Shrine, in the northern part of Ebisugaoka.
Go back to @loc{Sakuko's House} and open the mailbox.

achievements.description: Defeated Sakuko without getting hit by the suzu bell attack.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Sakuko-like boss at the end of the Corridors without being hit by her suzu bell attack.

steps.text: Listen for where she teleports and hit her while she charges the bell attack to stop it.
If the attack hits you, reload the autosave.

achievements.displayName: Go Away! You'll Ruin the Shop's Reputation!
achievements.description: Defeated the Giant Monster in front of Chizuruya General Store.
achievements.summary: Kill the Giant Monster standing outside the Chizuruya General Store.

steps.text: Once the Sakuko-like boss is down, head to the @loc{Chizuruya General Store} rather than taking the alleys toward the Middle School.
Kill the Giant Monster that guards the store front.

achievements.description: Stopped a certain number of enemies behind the white rabbit crest door from reanimating.
achievements.summary: Keep every enemy beyond the white rabbit crest door from getting back up.

guide.context: On New Game+ you can use Soul Siphon instead. If the achievement does not unlock, look for a hidden Kashimashi.

steps.text: In Sakuko's area of the @loc{Worship Hall}, go through the white rabbit crest door.
Defeat all 9 enemies. Do it in rooms with blue light, or lure them to blue lamps, so they cannot get up again. One enemy spawns when you enter the rabbit hutch.

achievements.description: Escaped from the Fog Monster at Sugisato without getting hit.
achievements.summary: Escape the second Fog Monster at Sugisato without being hit.

steps.text: The chase starts when you jump off the ledge at the @loc{Mountain Refuge}. It continues behind the metal gate.
Do not touch any red-glowing vine and do not get hit by an enemy.
The @item{Horse} omamori reduces stamina use while running.

achievements.description: Defeated Rinko without being hit by her puppets.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Rinko-like boss without being hit by her puppets.

steps.text: In the @loc{Main Hall}, after the final ritual, fight her. Dodge the puppets' charged attacks or kill the puppets before they blow up. Being hit by Rinko herself is fine.
If a puppet hits you, reload the autosave.

achievements.description: Discovered the Thousand Year Cedar.
achievements.summary: Reach the Divine Tree, the Thousand Year Cedar.

steps.text: In chapter 8, walk to the Thousand Year Cedar, which lies southwest of Shu's house, on the west side of the Forgotten Shrine.

achievements.displayName: Just Shut Up for Once, Dad!
achievements.description: Defeated Hinako's father before her mother at the Shimizu residence.
achievements.summary: Defeat Hinako's father before her mother in the Shimizu Residence parents fight.

steps.text: Against the two parents, attack only the father and leave the mother alone until he falls.

achievements.description: Obtained all the crests without making a single mistake on the Inari statue puzzle.
achievements.summary: Collect all crests in the Treasure Hall puzzle without entering a dead end.

guide.context: The achievement unlocks when you take the last crest.

steps.text: Take the left-hand door.
Take the right-hand door, then the one directly ahead.
Take the next door on the left.

achievements.description: Caught up with the Fog Monster 3 times.
achievements.summary: Close in on the Fog Monster three times during the chase that follows the mural puzzle.

steps.text: Once the @loc{Treasure Hall} mural is solved, pursue the Fog Monster down the hill to the Chizuruya General Store. Reach it three separate times.

achievements.description: Defeated the Shiromuku without dying once.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Shiromuku in the Normal ending without dying once.

guide.context: This achievement exists only in the Normal ending.

steps.text: On a later run, take at least one @item{Red Capsule} so the game ends with the Normal ending. This step is not needed on your first run.
Fight the @enemy{Shiromuku} and win without a single death. On Story or Hard action difficulty a death restarts the current phase and voids the achievement.
If you die, reload your last save and try the fight again.

achievements.description: Defeated all the summoned monsters before putting an end to the Shichibi.
achievements.summary: Defeat every monster the Shichibi summons before finishing it off.

steps.text: Reach the final fight of the Fox Wets Its Tail ending with the unpurified @item{Sacred Sword}.
Kill each of the three waves of summoned monsters quickly, before the @enemy{Shichibi}'s next attack finishes charging.
Only then defeat the @enemy{Shichibi}.

achievements.description: Defeated the Tsukumogami without getting hit by a single arrow.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Tsukumogami in the Fox's Wedding ending without being hit by a single arrow.

guide.context: This achievement exists only in the Fox's Wedding ending.

steps.text: Reach the @enemy{Tsukumogami} fight in the Fox's Wedding ending.
Halfway through, the boss fires arrows from range and moves you to the arena edge. Run toward it, dodge the first set of arrows, and hit it to stop the attack.
Equip the @item{Horse} and @item{Boar} omamori to make the run easier.

achievements.description: Defeated both the Tsukumogami and the Kyubi within 10 minutes of the fight starting.
achievements.summary: Beat the Tsukumogami and the Kyubi inside 10 minutes of the battle beginning.

guide.context: This achievement exists only in the Ebisugaoka in Silence ending.

steps.text: Reach the final fight of the Ebisugaoka in Silence ending.
Defeat both @enemy{Tsukumogami} and @enemy{Kyubi} within 10 minutes of the fight's start.
Equip @item{Beetle}, @item{Boar}, @item{Rabbit}, @item{Serpent} and @item{Suzuran} omamori to help.

achievements.description: Reached the Iwai residence without taking a single capsule and left the capsules on Shu's desk in his workshop.
achievements.summary: Reach Shu's house without taking any Red Capsule, in New Game+.

steps.text: Do not take or use any @item{Red Capsule} on the way up the mountain to Shu's house.
Leave the capsules on the desk in Shu's workshop untouched.
Open the @item{Letter to My Partner} inside the shed. Every Red Capsule then vanishes.

achievements.description: Obtained the Sacred Sword after uncovering its legend.
achievements.summary: Get the Sacred Sword in New Game+ after offering five items to Jizo statues.

guide.context: If you already did the offerings in an earlier run, take the sword at the second Jizo or the Divine Tree.

steps.text: Get the @item{Faded Bride Doll}: in the first house on the left halfway down the mountain, take the @item{Balcony Key} from the upstairs left room, cross the balcony to the next room for the @item{Treasure Hunting Game Key}, and open the treasure box in the downstairs pantry. Offer it to the Jizo further down on the left.
Take the @item{Rusted Flask} from the Sennensugi Shrine at the far north. The Jizo for it stands between that shrine and the rice field.
Take the @item{Broken Japanese Geta Sandal} from the top of the broken bridge near the Middle School. Its Jizo is across that bridge.
After the Worship Hall, find the @item{Cracked Hibachi Brazier} on the right of the shed behind Shu's house. Its Jizo is midway back toward the Forgotten Shrine.
Down the path from Shu's house, pull @item{Dad's Old Kitchen Knife} out of the tree behind the right-hand house. Its Jizo is up a staircase by the left-hand house.
Go to the Thousand Year Cedar southwest of Shu's house to get the @item{Sacred Sword}.

achievements.description: Obtained the small vial containing the Agura no Hotei-sama.
achievements.summary: Get the small vial holding the Agura no Hotei-sama in New Game+.

steps.text: Upstairs in the @loc{Main Hall}, stand near the second Ritual Chamber.
Clear the wall with Focus, then go through the door bearing an Inari-sama seal into the @loc{Hermitage of Crimson Water}.
Take the vial from the table in the uphill house.

achievements.description: Purified the Sacred Sword.
achievements.summary: Purify the Sacred Sword in New Game+.

steps.text: Have the @item{Sacred Sword} from the Jizo offerings.
In the @loc{Main Hall}, go upstairs near the second Ritual Chamber, clear the wall with Focus, and open the door with the Inari-sama seal to enter the @loc{Hermitage of Crimson Water}.

Inside the @loc{Hermitage of Crimson Water}, read the stone's hint. Then ring three bells, timed with the bamboo water device: Mountain Bell (uphill house), Water Bell (beside the lower stone), Tree Bell (stone bridge).
Defeat the Rinko-like boss.
On the road toward the Shimizu Residence, purify the sword in the water basin at the old Inari-sama statue.

achievements.description: Offered the Brooch to the ancient Jizo statue.
achievements.summary: Hand the Brooch over at the ancient Jizo statue during a New Game++ run.

steps.text: First unlock every sealed room and box with Inari-sama's mark. See the Inari-sama's Secrets guide.
Heading toward the Shimizu Residence, present the @item{Brooch} to the statue of the ancient Jizo. You earn the Brooch by beating your parents in the run before.

achievements.description: Fully upgraded Health, Sanity, and Stamina.
achievements.summary: Fully upgrade Health, Sanity and Stamina.

guide.context: Each upgrade costs one Ema and 500 to 2,000 Faith. Reload the save before buying hokora omamori so Faith is shared across both goals.

steps.text: Collect 18 of the 22 @item{Ema}. They are spread through every area, and some only appear in New Game+ and New Game++.
Enshrine valuable offerings at hokora to earn about 22,500 Faith.
Make a manual save, then buy every Health, Sanity and Stamina upgrade at a hokora.

achievements.description: Obtained all the items that increase inventory size.
achievements.summary: Obtain all six items that increase inventory size.

guide.context: Progress carries over between playthroughs.

achievements.description: Opened all rooms and boxes marked with Inari-sama's seal.
achievements.summary: Open all 11 rooms and boxes marked with Inari-sama's seal.

guide.context: Only New Game+ and later. Opening each door or box once is enough, even though they re-seal in later runs. Finish all of them prior to giving the Brooch to the ancient Jizo.

collectibles.name: Seal 1
collectibles.location: Downstairs on the right, a short way past the first Antique Comb offering
collectibles.method: Open it. It also holds a Diary of Revenge page and an Ema.

collectibles.name: Seal 2
collectibles.location: At the rear of the big tree, southeast side
collectibles.method: Open it. It holds the Shrew Mole omamori.

collectibles.name: Seal 9

collectibles.name: Seal 10

collectibles.method: Open it. It also holds a Diary of Revenge page and an Ema.

collectibles.name: Seal 11

achievements.displayName: The Truth about the Tsuneki Family
achievements.description: Obtained the following documents:  "Housemaid's Note"  "Family Physician's Log"  "Strict Mother's Letter"
achievements.summary: Obtain the Housemaid's Note, Family Physician's Log and Strict Mother's Letter documents.

guide.context: All 14 pages are needed.

collectibles.name: Housemaid's Note 1/4
collectibles.location: First aisle of the library
collectibles.method: Pick it up.

collectibles.name: Family Physician's Log 1/5
collectibles.location: Library, right after Housemaid's Note 1
collectibles.method: Pick it up.

collectibles.name: Family Physician's Log 2/5
collectibles.location: Library, shortly after Log 1
collectibles.method: Pick it up.

collectibles.name: Family Physician's Log 3/5
collectibles.location: First floor, open area with many doors
collectibles.method: Pick it up.

collectibles.name: Housemaid's Note 2/4
collectibles.location: Past a liftable door on the west edge of the open room
collectibles.method: Available after the first ritual. The Crow omamori is here too.

collectibles.name: Family Physician's Log 4/5
collectibles.location: Hidden behind a wall at the southwest of the ground-floor open room
collectibles.method: Available after the final ritual.

collectibles.name: Strict Mother's Letter 1/5
collectibles.location: At the foot of the old Inari-sama statue
collectibles.method: Pick it up.

collectibles.name: Strict Mother's Letter 2/5
collectibles.location: Fenced front yard on the left past the playground
collectibles.method: Pick it up.

collectibles.name: Strict Mother's Letter 3/5
collectibles.location: Beside the hokora just outside that yard
collectibles.method: Pick it up.

collectibles.name: Family Physician's Log 5/5
collectibles.location: First central room with fox statues
collectibles.method: Activate the fox statue to get the scroll, then go through the door it faces.

collectibles.name: Housemaid's Note 3/4
collectibles.location: Next to the first sealed box (the one that takes the Black Sparrow Crest), on its left
collectibles.method: On leaving the Black Sparrow Crest room, use the left door next to the hokora.

collectibles.name: Housemaid's Note 4/4
collectibles.location: Between the Mural Puzzle room and the second fox-statue room
collectibles.method: Examine the bloodstain on the right wall with Focus to reveal a fox statue. Grab the Pity Scroll, then enter the door the statue looks at.

collectibles.name: Strict Mother's Letter 4/5
collectibles.location: Second room with fox statues
collectibles.method: Examine the bloodstain on the left wall with Focus to reveal another fox statue, then enter the door that statue looks at.

collectibles.name: Strict Mother's Letter 5/5
collectibles.location: Right side of the third fox-statue room
collectibles.method: New Game+ only. Activate the fox statue, then enter the door it faces, near the sealed door.

collectibles.name: Diary of Revenge 2/6

collectibles.name: Diary of Revenge 5/6

collectibles.method: New Game+ only; opens with the Inari-sama seal.

collectibles.name: Diary of Revenge 6/6

collectibles.name: Sakuko's Diary 1/8

collectibles.method: Pick it up.

collectibles.name: Sakuko's Diary 2/8
collectibles.location: Fourth bench in the locker room
collectibles.method: Pick it up. If you missed it, you get 2/8 and 3/8 together on the next run.

collectibles.name: Sakuko's Diary 3/8
collectibles.location: Fourth bench in the locker room
collectibles.method: Same spot as 2/8, on a later run.

collectibles.name: Sakuko's Diary 4/8
collectibles.location: Last bench in the locker room
collectibles.method: Appears on New Game++.

collectibles.name: Sakuko's Diary 5/8
collectibles.location: Next to the second green and red switch
collectibles.method: Pick it up.

collectibles.name: Sakuko's Diary 6/8
collectibles.location: Next to the altar from Sakuko's dream
collectibles.method: Pick it up.

collectibles.name: Sakuko's Diary 7/8
collectibles.location: Next to the altar from Sakuko's dream
collectibles.method: Same spot as 6/8, on a later run.

collectibles.name: Sakuko's Diary 8/8
collectibles.location: Next to the altar from Sakuko's dream
collectibles.method: Same spot as 6/8, on New Game++. Missed pages appear together.

achievements.description: Obtained all the following documents: "Rinko's Diary"
achievements.summary: Obtain all five Rinko's Diary documents.

guide.context: Pages 1 and 2 appear in New Game+. Pages 3 to 5 appear in New Game++.

collectibles.name: Rinko's Diary 1/5
collectibles.location: Table in the classroom behind the white crest door
collectibles.method: Take it before using the lamp. New Game+.

collectibles.name: Rinko's Diary 2/5
collectibles.location: Same classroom
collectibles.method: Take it after using the lamp. New Game+.

collectibles.name: Rinko's Diary 3/5
collectibles.location: Same classroom
collectibles.method: New Game++. Check the room before and after using the lamp.

collectibles.name: Rinko's Diary 4/5
collectibles.location: Rinko's Room behind the green crest door
collectibles.method: New Game++.

collectibles.name: Rinko's Diary 5/5
collectibles.location: Chizuruya General Store behind the red crest door
collectibles.method: New Game++. Take it after using the lamp. This unlocks the achievement.

achievements.description: Obtained all the following documents: "Clinical Trial"

collectibles.method: Pick it up. One page appears in each playthrough.

collectibles.name: Clinical Trial 2/3
collectibles.location: The yard of the first house to your right
collectibles.method: Pick it up.

collectibles.name: Clinical Trial 3/3
collectibles.location: Area with two houses, near the Jizo upstairs
collectibles.method: Pick it up.
